name: Camp NAC
description_short: Build your own summer day camp at the Newtown Athletic Club for ages 3 to 15, with 14 weeks to pick from and more than 75 themed camps in sports, cooking, creative arts and STEAM alongside NACster, the traditional day camp with games, crafts and swimming.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least 24 hours before a registered day to request a camp credit voucher, less a $50 nonrefundable deposit per week and the registration fee; credits last a year. No cash refunds. Week or program transfers are free before May 31 and $20 after June 1.
swim_waterfront_notes: Every camper takes a swim test the first week; those who do not pass wear a Coast Guard approved flotation device. NACster groups swim an hour four times a week at the outdoor water park (zero entry pool up to 4.5 feet, two slides with a 48 inch height rule, splash pad, lazy river), with Red Cross certified lifeguards.
notes: Families choose any number of weeks and mix programs: NACster traditional camp (K to grade 7, 9 to 3), NACventures, sports, cooking, creative arts, STEAM, teen CIT or Teen Adventure (ages 13 to 15) and NAC Early Learners (ages 3 to 4). NACster runs all 14 weeks; most themed camps run weeks 3 to 11. Rates are given only through a request form, so no price is listed. Multi week and sibling discounts. Village Farm Camp (ages 6 to 12) meets at a separate farm site in Langhorne and has its own listing.
